title: Cloud Tenant Provisioning
scenario: NewVue Health is transitioning from an on-premises AD environment to a hybrid cloud model using Microsoft 365 Business Premium. As the lead administrator, you must finalize the tenant provisioning, ensure the 'NewVue Blue' identity is enforced, and validate the environment before the Phase 3 hybrid-sync begins.

activities.title: Task 1: The Provisioning Sequence
activities.prompt: You need to bring the tenant from an unconfigured state to a branded, validated state. Move the administrative actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct sequence.
steps: Verify 'Business Premium' status in the Billing portal
Navigate to Entra ID > Company Branding
Upload the full NewVue Health logo PNG
Apply the #003D79 background color hex code
Validate appearance via Incognito browser session
answer: Verify 'Business Premium' status in the Billing portal
Navigate to Entra ID > Company Branding
Upload the full NewVue Health logo PNG
Apply the #003D79 background color hex code
Validate appearance via Incognito browser session
activities.explanation: Licensing must be confirmed before branding, and branding requires a clean browser session (Incognito) for immediate validation.

activities.title: Task 2: Identity Configuration Mapping
activities.prompt: Match each NewVue Health requirement to the specific configuration field within the Microsoft Entra admin center.

pairs.left: Welcome to NewVue Health – Authorized Users Only

activities.explanation: Correct field mapping ensures the sign-in experience matches the corporate identity standards defined in the lab.

activities.title: Task 3: Domain & Portal Scope
activities.prompt: You are managing a hybrid environment. Match the administrative endpoint or domain to its primary functional role in Phase 2.
activities.explanation: Distinguishing between the legacy local domain and the new cloud tenant domain is critical for hybrid identity success.

activities.title: Task 4: Validation Logic
activities.prompt: A technician reports that branding changes are not visible after saving. What is the most likely administrative oversight?
options: The browser is using cached CSS from the previous login
The logo file size exceeds the 10MB limit
The user is signing in with a .local account
The Global Admin role has been revoked
activities.answer: The browser is using cached CSS from the previous login
activities.explanation: Browser caching is the primary hurdle in M365 branding validation; using Incognito/Private mode is the standard fix.
